$comment: #EXP-2172 (epic #EXP-2169, plan revision 2 section 4): THE CI PAGE x4 (view `ci`: web /ci, the desktop's CI screen, iOS and Android's CI destination; the More menu's CI entry on phones), one ROOT row after Devices (sidebar-tree.json: Assistant, Home, Needs you, Chats, Drafts, Devices, CI, Teams), across every member team (there is no active team). DATA, all synced, never fetched: `ci_runs` + `ci_jobs` (shapes ci-runs / ci-jobs: our runs AND GitHub Actions runs, `provider` exponential | github, the server ingests GitHub's workflow_run / workflow_job webhooks), `pull_requests` (merge state, position, train id, root session), the sessions shape (a root's starter), the repositories shape (full names), the devices shape (rows whose `runner.enabled` is true = the runners; `lastSeenAt`). RULES (`ciRunList`, `ciRepoOptions`, `ciPageTiles`, `ciBadge`, `ciTrainGroups`, `ciRunnerRows`, `ciTabCounts`, replayed by every mirror over the cases below, comparing the WHOLE result): a run's status is ci-run.json `runStatus` over its jobs; its order is NEWEST FIRST by startedAt (else createdAt), ties by id; source = `github` for provider github, else `exponential` (copy.sources); `mine` = the viewer started it (createdByUserId: a push, a re-run, a GitHub actor linked to the viewer's GitHub account) or its pull request's root session was started by the viewer. FILTERS: status All | Running (running + queued) | Failed | Mine; a repository pick (`ciRepoOptions`: All repositories, then every repository with a run, by name); a source pick (Every source, Exponential, GitHub Actions). At most `limits.runs` rows. A row: identifier `#n`, title `#n name`, the status glyph/tone of repo-ci.json, repository full name (copy.unknownRepository while its row has not synced), source label, ref (repo-ci copy.runs.noRef when none), trigger = copy.pullRequest with the PR's number for a pull request run whose PR is known, else copy.triggers[trigger] (unknown = the raw value), duration = pr-checks formatDuration of (completedAt or now) - startedAt (null before it started), startedAt, subtitle (phones) = `repository · ref · source`. TILES (`ciPageTiles`): Running, Queued, Failed today = failed runs completed in the last 24 hours (tone danger and delta = the newest failure's repository NAME, the part after the last `/`, when any), Runners = copy.tiles.runnersValue over runners online (lastSeenAt younger than `limits.runnerOnlineMs`) of all. THE BADGE (nav-badges.json destination `ci`, `ciBadge`): over the viewer's runs only, the NEWEST run per (repository, pipeline name, ref): any failed = that count, tone `attention` (a green re-run is newer and clears it); else the running or queued ones, tone `muted`; else 0 (no badge). The phones' More tab sums it with its other items (Phase 1). MERGE TRAIN (`ciTrainGroups(input, queue)`): per repository (by name; caption = the PRs' base branch) the TESTING batches (PRs in merge state testing grouped by mergeTrainId, by lowest number): one row each, identifier = the first member's `#n`, title = the PR's title alone or copy.train.batch with {count}, subtitle = the members `#n title` joined by ` · ` (alone: none), glyph ci-running, badge = merge-train.json copy.pill.testing. The Runs tab shows the testing batches only (queue false) above the runs; the Merge train tab (queue true) adds the queued PRs by mergePosition (badge = merge-train.json copy.pill.queuedAt with its `ordinal` position, copy.pill.queued without one; glyph ci-queued) and then the ones waiting (checks | held | conflict | failing, by number, badge = merge-train.json copy.pill checksRunning | onHold | conflict | failing, glyph ci-queued for checks, ci-skipped for held, else ci-failed). A row opens its pull request (a batch: its first member). RUNNERS (`ciRunnerRows`): online first, then by name; title = the device label, subtitle = its labels (runner-settings.json `runnerOsLabel` first, then its own lower-cased; copy.runners.noLabels when none), busy = copy.runners.busy over our in-progress jobs on it and its slots (online only), queue = copy.runners.queue over OUR queued, undispatched jobs whose runsOn it covers (null when none), offlineSince = its lastSeenAt while offline (drawn as the catalog's `fill` of copy.runners.offlineSince with {time} = its `formatRelativeTime`). No lanes. TAB COUNTS (`ciTabCounts`): Merge train = its rows (queue true), Runners = the runners. LAYOUT is pinned node for node by ci-page-view.json (the reference apps/web/src/lib/ci-page-view.ts). testIds name the parts for the e2e and the shots.
